assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D RPG combat pose atlas. Input image is a character identity/style reference, not a target to overwrite. Create EIGHT distinct full-body poses of this exact brown-haired wasteland drifter with patched olive jacket, brown trousers, leather boots and small backpack, same painted retro isometric game style. Layout: exactly FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, generous transparent gaps, each full character entirely contained in its cell. Every character faces screen-right in the same three-quarter back isometric angle as the reference. Same head/body scale in all cells. Upper row left-to-right: 1 idle fighting stance with empty fists; 2 overhead melee windup, right fist raised high behind head; 3 fully extended forward melee strike, right fist reaching toward screen-right; 4 firearm aiming pose with both empty hands forward at shoulder height ready to hold a weapon overlay. Lower row left-to-right: 5 crouched defensive brace with forearms shielding chest; 6 recoiling in pain with torso bent backward; 7 collapsing onto one knee; 8 lying exhausted on side, alive, no blood. Hands EMPTY in ALL poses, no weapons baked in because the game overlays actual equipment. True transparent alpha background. No ground, shadows, scenery, text, labels, dividers, gridlines, watermark. Prioritize clearly different articulated limb silhouettes, consistent costume and sharp small-scale readability. Canvas landscape 2048x1536 if possible. Feet baseline within each standing cell near 90% cell height, bodies fit without clipping.
